hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"Pull request follow-up here is event-driven: subscribe to a PR you open so its webhook events arrive, act on them as they come, and otherwise look at a PR when handed the next task or asked directly.
